title: rubricate rubric
description: A portable, versionable evaluation rubric for LLM responses and agent trajectories (spec v0.1).

spec.description: Version of the rubricate spec this file is written against.

id.description: Stable identifier for this rubric. Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores.

description.description: What this rubric evaluates and when to use it.

subject.description: What is being graded: a single model response, or a full agent run (messages plus tool calls).

criteria.description: The criteria that make up the rubric. At least one is required.

criterion.description: Either a scored criterion (graded on a numeric scale) or an assertion (pass/fail rule).

scored.description: A criterion graded on a numeric scale with a written anchor for each level.

question.description: The question a rater or judge answers for this criterion.

weight.description: Relative importance when combining criterion scores. Defaults to 1.

scale.description: Map of score level to the anchor text that describes it. Keys are non-negative integers.

examples.description: Worked examples that show what a given score looks like.

assertion.description: A pass/fail rule, typically over the order and arguments of an agent's tool calls.

rule.description: The rule in plain language. A machine-checkable form is added in a later spec version.

severity.description: blocker: a failure fails the whole evaluation. warning: reported but not fatal.

score.description: The scale level this example illustrates.

input.description: Optional prompt or context the output responds to.

output.description: The response (or trajectory summary) being illustrated.

rationale.description: Why this output earns this score.
